title: Gumroad digital products
one_liner: Sell guides, templates and presets from a simple checkout page.
pay: You set the price; Gumroad takes 10% + 50c per direct sale (plus card processing), 30% via Discover.
steps: Pick one problem your viewers ask about.
Make a short guide or template.
Set up a Gumroad product page.
Link it in your bio and mention it in videos.
catch: Fees on every sale, and nobody finds it unless you send them there.

match.first_step: Outline a 5-page guide answering your most-asked question.
